LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_CoA_Novice_1: {PAWN} prayed at the crater's edge and came back with a pocket full of scrap the Glow hadn't claimed yet.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_CoA_Novice_2: {PAWN} chased off a handful of scavengers picking through hallowed ground and came back with little to show for it.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_CoA_Novice_3: {PAWN} found a small camp of the fearful and spent the day trying to open their eyes to Atom's truth.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_CoA_Novice_4: {PAWN} spent the pilgrimage clearing raiders out of a shrine they had no business squatting in.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_CoA_Veteran_1: {PAWN} broke a settlement that refused to hear Atom's word and made sure the next one would listen.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_CoA_Veteran_2: {PAWN} hunted down a band of apostates and reminded them what the Glow does to the faithless.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_CoA_Veteran_3: {PAWN} spent the mission charting a stretch of hot ground, marking it fit for the next shrine.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_CoA_Veteran_4: {PAWN} came back with radiation scars and a handful of new converts in tow.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_CoA_Elite_1: {PAWN} walked into a crater hot enough to kill most of the faithful, and walked back out untouched.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_CoA_Elite_2: {PAWN} carried out the pilgrimage exactly as Atom demanded, no witnesses left to doubt it.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_CoA_Elite_3: {PAWN} spent the better part of two weeks deep in the Glow and returned with a vision the Nucleus will want to hear.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_CoA_Elite_4: {PAWN} didn't speak much of what was seen out there, only that Atom's will had been done.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_CoA_Sentinel_1: {PAWN} pushed past the edge of any ground the faithful hold, charting a crater for the next crusade.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_CoA_Sentinel_2: {PAWN} came back from unclaimed land with word of a crater ready to kneel to Atom.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_CoA_Sentinel_3: {PAWN} spent nearly two weeks beyond contact and returned with news the High Confessor will want to hear directly.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_CoA_Sentinel_4: {PAWN} walked back into the Nucleus carrying proof of what was found at the edge of the map, ash and radiance in equal measure.
